bug_semantics: On an exit relay, conflux_process_link() accepted RELAY_COMMAND_CONFLUX_LINK on a circuit that already had n_streams or resolving_streams from a preceding RELAY_COMMAND_BEGIN. Linking then called cfx_add_leg() -> validate_circ_has_no_streams(), which treated the attached streams as a BUG and nullified the list head without clearing each edge connection's on_circuit back-pointer. The orphaned stream later used that dangling pointer when the circuit was freed, causing a use-after-free (TROVE-2026-025).
flaw_origin: The Prop#329 conflux pool first-write implemented conflux_process_link() with checks for origin circuits, extra hops, pending nonce, and already-linked state, but omitted a freshness check that LINK must arrive before any exit streams attach. The same commit introduced validate_circ_has_no_streams(), which silently dropped the stream-list head on unlinked OR circuits and thereby turned a BEGIN-then-LINK sequence into an orphan/UAF.
